narratives.author: claude
narratives.headline: Four games, all unders: Fox Under 6.5 assists leads a thin card while Portland's two questionable tags hang over two props
narratives.briefing: It is a light night with 4 games, and every prop on the card is an under, with no pick rated above Consider. The best of it is De'Aaron Fox Under 6.5 assists at conviction 47 and Tyler Herro Under 3.5 rebounds at conviction 46; the other three are rated Pass and Mikal Bridges has already moved past his play-to at −152. The record is mixed and should be read that way: morning picks are 3-2-0 (+0.54u), final picks 2-3-0 (-1.57u), and game lines are 13-26 (-14.41u) since 2026-11-11, so the totals below are leans only. Closing lines have moved toward the morning picks 3 times and against them 2 times. This edition goes out before official injury reports are final: we are waiting on Deni Avdija and Toumani Camara for Portland, which the model will re-price on the next run, and on Jonathan Kuminga for Minnesota; a morning search turned up no new news on any player in the props.

cards.p|4066259|ast|Under: Fox has averaged 4.6 assists over his last 10 and stayed under 6.5 in 8 of those, and the sim has him under in 77% of games with a projection of 4.7. What makes this wrong is the matchup: LAC gives point guards +8% assists and his history against them is 6.7 per game in 3 games; walk away if the line reaches 5.5 or the price goes past −146.
cards.p|4395725|reb|Under: The projection of 2.9 sits under the 3.5 line, the sim goes under in 63% of games, and POR is the #3 toughest matchup for shooting guard rebounds. The risk is that you are betting against DraftKings, whose price says 44%, and Portland's frontcourt status (Avdija and Camara are both questionable) could change the picture once the model re-prices.
cards.p|4683678|reb|Under: Henderson has gone under his posted line in 6 of 6 tracked games and under 2.5 in 9 of his last 10, with a projection of 1.6. It is rated Pass for good reason: 6 of his last 10 finished within 1 of the number, and on the road he is only 11 of 20 under 2.5.
cards.p|4845367|ast|Under: Castle projects for 5.3 assists against 6.5, and a 16-pt spread brings blowout risk that could cut his minutes. The case against is real: without Dylan Harper he has gone under in only 1 of 3, LAC is soft on point guard assists, and the market price says 44%, so this stays a Pass.
cards.p|3147657|ast|Under: The projection of 1.9 and a sim under rate of 66% support it, and MIN is the #5 toughest matchup for shooting guard assists. But the price of −152 is already past the play-to of −147, he has gone under in only 1 of 4 against MIN, and with Anthony Edwards out his minutes could run long, which is when this has missed.
